issuer: the Connecticut Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives a new regular licence at $84 (and a $40 examination fee, not held), issued for 5 1/2 to 7 years to expire on the birthday; renewals are 6 or 8 years, and the term is kept as 6 years, the middle of the first licence's span (a reading). A new non-driver ID card is $28, issued for seven years. The teen page sets restrictions for drivers aged 16 or 17, so a full licence is kept from 18. No youngest age for the card was read.
